transform_response_qwen2_bedrock: transform a Qwen2 Bedrock invoke response to OpenAI-compatible ModelResponse format
extract_generated_text_from_response: extract generated text from a Qwen2 Bedrock response using the 'text' or 'generation' field
strip_assistant_tokens_from_response: strip assistant start and end tokens from a Qwen2 generated text response
set_usage_info_on_model_response: set prompt, completion, and total token usage on a ModelResponse from Bedrock response data
log_bedrock_response_errors: log Bedrock Qwen2 response errors via LiteLLMLoggingObj.post_call with error details
